summary: Phase 135F: Canonical Transition Record Read-Only Prototype. Implemented the 135E plan's Stages 1-6 exactly within the frozen prototype boundary: src/pcae/cltr_prototype/ (models.py -- typed enums for all 14 lifecycle states, 16 transitions, retry/terminal/conformance/authority-role/commit-ownership/invariant-result/evidence/representation/failure/compatibility classifications, plus frozen TransitionRecord/Identity/EvidenceRef/CommitDeclaration dataclasses; identity.py -- explicit-only identity resolution reusing architecture_status.py's PHASE_ID_RE verbatim, zero title/filename/commit-subject/Git-history inference; state_machine.py -- one function per named transition T1-T16, no generic set_state, all 14 forbidden transitions rejected deterministically; invariants.py -- one evaluator per invariant ID from 135D Section 11's table (37 IDs; the 36-vs-37 discrepancy in 135D's own prose is documented, not silently resolved), never silently skipping an applicable invariant; canonicalization.py/digest.py -- deterministic JSON canonicalization and SHA-256 digesting with self-exclusion, tamper and cross-transition-substitution detection; generator.py -- fixture-driven orchestration with fail-closed three-outcome commit classification (unverifiable by default, never silently verified); verifier.py -- standalone offline re-verification; compatibility.py -- read-only legacy-artifact adapters, the only module permitted to parse a narrative title, comparison-only; comparison.py -- read-only cross-representation comparison with mixed-generation detection; persistence.py -- atomic, prototype-only writes under .pcae/cltr-prototypes/ with manifest-based crash recovery). Added the pcae cltr-prototype CLI (generate/show/verify/compare/list) wired into src/pcae/cli.py, disclosing prototype-only/non-canonical/non-authorization status on every invocation. Authored 15 hermetic fixtures covering the full required scenario set (successful transition, pre-certification failure, notification uncertainty, exact and conflicting replay, identity mismatch, stale report, mixed derivative generations, fabricated/contaminated/unverifiable commit ownership, tampered record, stale pointer, superseded transition, legacy artifact with no transition_id) and 170 focused tests (models, identity, state machine incl. all 16 permitted and 14 forbidden transitions, invariants, canonicalization/digest, generator, verifier, compatibility, comparison, persistence, CLI, and 30 import-graph/source-inspection safety tests). No production entry point, finalization module, or legacy authority was touched or repaired.
